body.name: Iess
body.type: finite invariant raw essential-incidence index set for a saturated order
body.def: \(\mathcal I_T=\{\operatorname{dir}(i,j):i,j\in W,\ i\ne j\}\cup\{\operatorname{src}(C,j):\varnothing\ne C\subseteq W,\ j\in C\}\), with \( |\mathcal I_T|\le N(N-1)+N2^{N-1}\).  The label \(C\) denotes a formal saturated source slot.  Its realized child set is determined by its positive incidence signs; empty realized sets are discarded and equal nonempty realized sets are merged before projection.  Both the raw index and the normalized realized index are invariant to source-value, source-order, and response-label permutations.
